scientific_integrity: An exact marked enumeration, a published smooth multivariate coefficient-transfer theorem, and finite independently enumerated checks support the stated limit. The equal-part limit is explicitly prior work and not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Aspect ratio tends to a constant strictly between zero and infinity; no total-variation error rate or independently certified originality. The general singularity-analysis lemma is imported from published work, and several historical sources were not accessible in full.
title: Two-parameter sink-side law for unbalanced random bipartite acyclic orientations
